item.title: Oklahoma Gov Kevin Stitt announces who he’s tapping to replace Markwayne Mullin in the US Senate
item.description: Republican Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt announces Alan Armstrong as his choice to fill the U.S. Senate seat vacated by next DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin.

item.title: Former Playboy model Kendra Wilkinson opts for GLP-1 shots instead of new jeans: ‘Mama is on a budget’
item.description: Kendra Wilkinson says she plans to start GLP-1 weight-loss shots after turning 40, noting her jeans feel tighter but insisting she is happy and at peace.

item.title: Rubio testifies in trial of ex-Florida congressman allegedly hired by Maduro government to lobby for Venezuela
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio is testifying on Tuesday in Miami, Florida, in the federal trial of former Miami congressman and roommate David Rivera.

item.title: Major airline tightens window for passengers to seek compensation after baggage delays
item.description: In a new policy change, Delta Air Lines has cut its baggage claim filing window from three days to two hours, requiring travelers to act fast after domestic flights arrive.

item.title: Illegal alien accused of slitting Salt Lake woman’s throat, ICE lodges detainer
item.description: An illegal alien from Mexico is charged with attempted murder after allegedly slitting a woman's throat in Salt Lake City as DHS demands he stay jailed.

item.title: Senate Republicans move to reopen DHS with new plan, wait for Democratic buy-in
item.description: A new Senate Republican framework would fund most of DHS but leave ICE enforcement unfunded, as Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, DpN.Y., says Democrats need to review the proposal.

item.title: Democratic Senate candidate laughs when pressed if voters can trust her after public Biden defense
item.description: Maine Gov. Janet Mills laughed when asked why voters should trust her after publicly backing Biden after the debate and revealing recently that she privately urged him to drop out.

item.title: DocuSign email scam targets healthcare workers
item.description: Cybercriminals are using fraudulent DocuSign emails to steal login credentials, urging users to verify unexpected document requests before clicking links.

item.title: FBI rescues missing autistic teen after two days lost in frigid wilderness
item.description: FBI agents rescued missing autistic teen Joel Medina in New Jersey after a nearly two-day search in near-freezing temperatures and rugged woods.

item.title: Mattis identifies ‘problem’ if US declares victory over Iran now
item.description: The U.S. is in a "tough spot" because Iran would claim control of the Strait of Hormuz if the war stopped now, former Defense Secretary Jim Mattis said.
